oneSentenceStory: Daniel reviews his 7,300 coin balance and tracks progress toward his Holiday Spending Money goal while managing statement credit redemptions.
customerSituation: Customer visits the rewards overview to check cashback accumulation and bill-offsetting options.
storyTension: Ensuring earned rewards translate directly to tangible bill reductions without wading through irrelevant lifestyle vouchers.
customerResolution: Displays clear points balance, holiday goal progress at 53%, and immediate statement credit allocation options.
primaryOutcome: Review statement credit accumulation and monitor progress toward holiday spending goals.
prohibitedDetours: Displaying travel vouchers or experience rewards
